mapper.update: UPDATE sw_im_bot SET owner_node=#{node},owner_version=owner_version+1, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
UPDATE sw_im_bot SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_node=#{node} AND owner_version=#{version} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE sw_im_bot SET owner_node=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_node=#{node} AND owner_version=#{version}

UPDATE sw_im_bot SET connection_state=#{state},last_error=#{error},last_heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_node=#{node} AND owner_version=#{version} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
